description.value: Daydreamer Wines is a sustainable, family-run winery on the Naramata Bench founded by Rachel and Marcus Ansems, where Marcus holds the Master of Wine designation. The winery produces limited-batch wines without systemic pesticides, herbicides, or fungicides, earning multiple platinum and gold medals at the National Wine Awards of Canada including Best Red Wine in Canada in 2019. Cyclists on the Naramata Bench can book a tasting at the on-site Wine Shack and purchase bottles to take away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates OSM identifiers (name, address, phone, email). No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging — are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those are all null. The winemaking philosophy page explicitly states 'Vegan Friendly — All of our wines are made without animal products or byproducts,' providing clear positive evidence for that optional amenity.
concerns: The /contactus subpage contains stale 2022 season closure text ('Our wine shack is now closed for the 2022 season. See you in April 2023'), suggesting the site is not fully maintained; the main page appears current and the business shows no signs of closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Daydreamer Wines is a well-established, award-winning winery directly on the Naramata Bench, a corridor popular with touring cyclists; the wine shop and bookable tasting shack make it a natural and worthwhile stop for the WWC directory.
